en: Mount Mayon in Albay is famous for having the most perfect cone among all volcanoes in the world.
The tamaraw is a small, hoofed mammal that is endemic to the island of Mindoro.
The Cagayan River is the longest river in the Philippines, flowing through the Cagayan Valley.
Laguna de Bay is the largest lake in the Philippines and is located near Metro Manila.
The island of Luzon contains the Sierra Madre, which is the longest mountain range in the Philippines.
The Philippines is the top global producer of abaca, a plant used to make strong ropes.
The Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park in Palawan features a navigable underground river flowing directly into the sea.
The Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park in the Sulu Sea is a UNESCO World Heritage site protecting diverse marine life.
The amihan is the cool northeast monsoon wind that brings dry weather to the Philippines from November to February.
Mount Apo in Mindanao is the highest peak in the Philippines, standing at 2,954 meters above sea level.
The Rafflesia, found in the rainforests of the Philippines, produces one of the largest individual flowers in the world.
The Chocolate Hills in Bohol consist of over 1,200 symmetrical limestone mounds that turn brown during the dry season.
